item.author: The New York Times (@nytimes.com)
item.description:
From @theathletic.com: The next WNBA commissioner will have to navigate labor fights, political firestorms, social media abuse and a league that hasn’t reached financial solvency.

Bless the brave woman who wants to inherit this burden, our columnist writes.
